notes.title: FIXED CRASHING BUG
notes.content:
[p]We sincerely apologize for the unexpected crashes that occurred when a gamepad was connected or disconnected during the splash screen. This was due to a compatibility issue between the game’s cursor system and gamepad input detection, which caused the game to close unexpectedly.[/p][p]The good news is: [b]it’s now fixed![/b]
You can connect or disconnect your controller safely without worrying about crashes.[/p][p]Thanks for your patience and support — we’re committed to making your experience as smooth as possible.[/p]
